nom: Patchology Eye Want Cake Smoothing & Hydrating Eye Patches

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive report a split: some say the patches burned, itched, or reddened within minutes despite being marketed as sensitive-friendly, while one reviewer with sensitive under-eyes reports no issues at all.
segments.mature: One reviewer using these around her 51st birthday and another noting fewer lines and better concealer wear associate the patches with reduced puffiness and dark circles on more mature under-eye skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention fewer lines, firmer-looking skin, and better concealer application after regular use, though these effects are described as subtle and tied mostly to the illuminating variant.
concerns.dehydration: The majority of reviewers report the under-eye area feels hydrated, soft, or moisturized after use; one reviewer felt the ingredients were not impressive despite the moist feel, and another found the patches too wet and uncomfortable.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the patches left redness and irritation under the eyes, which she attributes to the scent or sensitivity, contrasting with the many reports of soothing, cooling relief.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer specifically discusses barrier repair; comments center on hydration and comfort rather than barrier function.
concerns.spots: No reviewer discusses spots or hyperpigmentation for this eye-patch product.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewer discusses blemishes or breakouts, as this is an eye-area product rather than a general-face treatment.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer reports on oiliness; feedback for this product centers on the eye area's hydration and puffiness.

aspects.libelle: Good value for trial-size variety pack
Patches ripping or falling apart in packaging

extraits.texte: I was really excited to try these since everyone says they're great for sensitive skin — but honestly, they were a disappointment for me. Shortly after applying, my under-eyes started itching and burning — not just a little, but noticeable within 5 minutes. Definitely not what I expected from something labeled "sensitive skin friendly." The patches themselves felt super dry and didn't seem to have enough serum on them at all. I didn't experience the complaint about patches not sticking — these stuck just fine because the gel is very tacky — but the experience overall wasn't good. I generally love Patchology products, which is why this let-down was even more surprising. The design is cute, but unfortunately that's where the positives end for me.
